entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: A poison-ringed crime boss of Paliano whose network of spies and rogues controls much of the High City.

entities.name: Ervos Trax
entities.description: A charming criminal boss of the lowlands, Marchesa's longtime business partner, who poisons himself to deny her his death.

entities.name: Pietro Lokosh
entities.description: A sub-lieutenant in Marchesa's organization whom Ervos names as a target for extortion.

entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: A figure with whom Marchesa has arrangements, said by Ervos to guard the sewers.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The High City of Fiora where Marchesa's mansion stands.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane on which Paliano stands.

entities.name: Talon
entities.description: A city and its docks at the edge of Ervos's lowland criminal empire.

entities.name: Thousand Steps
entities.description: The long stair from the lowlands up into the High City.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: Guards of the city whom Ervos considers recruiting.

events.summary: Marchesa entertains her longtime business partner Ervos Trax at dinner in her mansion in Paliano.
events.quote: Marchesa was entertaining a guest and business partner from the lowlands, Ervos Trax.

events.summary: Ervos announces over dinner that he is going to have Marchesa killed, because his network is moving into the High City and she is his only obstacle.
events.quote: I think I am going to have you killed

events.summary: Ervos walks Marchesa through why a direct attack or poisoning would fail, noting her zombie guards, escape routes and food precautions.
events.quote: So, killing you through your food would be out of the question.

events.summary: Ervos explains the plan to corrupt a trusted lieutenant such as Pietro Lokosh, and Marchesa names him before Ervos does.
Ervos, coughing blood, reveals that he has poisoned himself because one of them would have to die.
events.quote: So instead of letting you kill me, I would poison myself

events.summary: Marchesa admits she planned to have Ervos killed in two nights and that she will now be blamed; she praises his play.
events.quote: I had planned to have you killed at your secret penthouse in your sleep two nights from now.

events.summary: Ervos dies slumped into his plate, and Marchesa leaves to summon her butler, who has already dug a hole for the body.
events.quote: then slumped forward, face into his plate, dead.

relations.note: Longstanding business partners who are also rivals.
relations.quote: Marchesa and Ervos were longstanding business partners.

relations.note: Ervos plans her murder to take over the High City.
relations.quote: You, Dear Friend, are my only obstacle.

relations.note: Pietro is one of Marchesa's sub-lieutenants.
relations.quote: As one of your sub-lieutenants, Pietro Lokosh would be the sort of person I would use.

relations.note: Her mansion is among the elite homes of the High City.
relations.quote: Situated among the elite of Paliano, the High City
